sig: [[["A", "Hi, is this IT security? I think I may have received a phishing email."], ["B", "You've come to the right place. What made you suspicious?"], ["A", "It looked like it came from our payroll provider, asking me to confirm my bank details by Friday or my salary would be delayed. But the sender's address ended in dot-co instead of dot-com."], ["B", "Good catch. Did you click the link or download anything?"], ["A", "I clicked the link, but as soon as the login page came up, something felt off, so I closed it. I didn't type anything in."], ["B", "OK, that's reassuring. Still, to be on the safe side, I'll need you to change your password within the next hour."], ["A", "Sure. Should I delete the email?"], ["B", "Not yet. And please don't forward it. Use the 'Report phishing' button in Outlook instead. That sends us the full message headers."], ["A", "Will do. Has anyone else gotten it?"], ["B", "You're the third person this morning, so I'll send a company-wide alert shortly."]], {"A": "F-AU", "B": "M-US"}]
